            "Bash(codex:*)",
            "Bash(*claude -p*)",
            "Bash(*codex exec*)"
        ],
        "defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"
    },
    "skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt": true
}

            "Read(//accounts/a/settings.local.json)",

            "Edit(//accounts/a/statsig)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/statsig/**)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/logs)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/logs/**)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/logs)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/logs/**)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/debug)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/debug/**)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/debug)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/debug/**)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/shell-snapshots)",
            "Read(//accounts/a/shell-snapshots/**)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/shell-snapshots)",
            "Edit(//accounts/a/shell-snapshots/**)",
            "Edit(//accounts/**)",
            "Bash(security:*)",
            "Bash(secret-tool:*)",
            "Bash(claude auth:*)",
            "Bash(claude login:*)",
            "Bash(claude logout:*)",
            "Bash(claude setup-token:*)"

        "enabled": true,
        "autoAllowBashIfSandboxed": false,
        "allowUnsandboxedCommands": false
    }
